name: rare-disease-genetic-counseling
description: Review-centered decision support for rare-disease constitutional and germline genetic counseling.

profession.zh: 罕见病胚系遗传咨询助理

displayDescription.en: Structures rare-disease cases and HPO terms, reviews variant tables, proposes sequence-variant and CNV classifications, finds literature, and drafts counseling summaries. Every output is a proposal for qualified human review.
displayDescription.zh: 罕见病胚系遗传咨询：整理病例与HPO，复核变异表，提出变异与CNV分级建议，检索文献，起草咨询小结。

quickPrompts.en: Help me structure a rare-disease case and propose HPO terms
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我整理罕见病病例并提出 HPO 术语建议

quickPrompts.en: Review the variant table from a testing company
quickPrompts.zh: 复核检测公司提供的变异表

quickPrompts.en: Propose an ACMG classification for a germline CNV
quickPrompts.zh: 为一个胚系 CNV 提出 ACMG 分级建议

defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me structure a rare-disease case and propose HPO terms
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我整理罕见病病例并提出 HPO 术语建议
